title: Forty Variations for piano - 40-page document

expected.notes: One Piano part (grand staff) over 40 page(s); every page is one variation with its own key, metre, tempo + metronome mark and rehearsal number (1, 2, ...). Pages are separated by double barlines + page breaks; systems hold 4 bars.

scan.pdf.seed_rule: page k (0-based) is damaged with numpy default_rng(seed * 1000 + k)
scan.pdf.summary: typical sheet-fed scan of every page: grey, 0.2-1.0 deg skew that differs per page, light blur + noise, JPEG q80

scan-severe.pdf.seed_rule: page k (0-based) is damaged with numpy default_rng(seed * 1000 + k)
scan-severe.pdf.summary: worn photocopies scanned in grey: 1.5-3.5 deg skew per page, bleed-through of the next page, strong lighting gradient, blur, noise, toner speckles, JPEG q35

notes: counts follow the rules in _tools/symcount.py (run it on a converter output for comparable numbers); every count except stanza-text is computed from truth.musicxml and was cross-checked against the LilyPond grob log of the engraving (ties, slurs, beams, flags, articulations, ornaments, dynamics, hairpins, pedals, fingerings, accidentals, ottavas, tuplets, ledger lines, lyrics, rehearsal / tempo marks, voltas, whole-bar rests, clef changes).
ledger-above / ledger-below count note heads that need ledger lines (derived from clef + octave-shift; MusicXML does not encode ledger lines).
stem-up / stem-down / beam / flag / accidental elements in the truth are exactly what LilyPond engraved (harvested from the instrumented engraving).
Page numbers are printed (pages >= 2) and encoded only as <credit> page numbers. Dynamics / hairpins / pedal marks are directions without placement attributes.
truth_limitations: Page numbers are printed (pages >= 2) and encoded only as <credit> page numbers. Dynamics / hairpins / pedal marks are directions without placement attributes.
source: own procedural composition for the coverage corpus (pieces/variations.py)
